Lia (docs): Quick sync — PR #4321 is ready (migration guide + SDK snippet). Docs preview is flaky in CI; linkcheck failing intermittently. I need someone to own review + merge during tonight's 4–6pm PT merge window. Any volunteers? @sam

Sam (eng): I can take reviewer duty, but need a clear LGTM checklist. Is linkcheck the only blocker?

Chris (docs): Linkcheck + one failing snippet test. Logs show timeout on external gist fetch. DeployBot posted error below.

DeployBot: build 4321-preview failed: node:fetch_gist timeout (10s). See https://ci.redwood/4321/logs

Pat (QA): I can run local link check and confirm. If Sam can do content review, I can approve after I patch the hardcoded URL.

Maria (docs): Suggest small policy: for flaky preview, proceed with manual linkcheck + hold if any tests fail > 1 min. Also we should update the snippet to inline the example to avoid gist dependency.

Lia (docs): Action plan: Sam reviews content, Pat runs linkcheck & pushes small fix if needed, Jordan will cover the merge window. I'll add label "review-needed" and tag the PR with "hold-if-ci-fails".

Jordan (doc-rotation): I got the merge window 4–6pm PT covered. Ping me at 4:00. If CI still flaky, we can merge with --no-verify after approvals and a quick sanity run (only if Pat confirms linkcheck locally).

Sam (eng): Quick nit: change `client.create(...)` to `await client.create(...)` in the JS snippet. I'll push a 1-line commit.

Pat (QA): Local linkcheck done — fixed two relative links and one redirect. Patch pushed.

Lia (docs): Perfect. Sam please leave an approval comment after you push. Jordan, I'll DM you at 15:55 PT. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 :party: 

Chris (docs): Thanks y'all. Can we also add a tiny note in the migration guide about the snippet change so downstream users don't get a runtime error?

Sam (eng): Good call — adding a one-line note in the doc now. Will tag the commit with `docs: clarify await in snippet`

Lia (docs): Awesome. Closing the loop here — will watch the thread and escalate if CI chops.

Jordan (doc-rotation): Copy. See you at 4.

DeployBot: deploy-notice: scheduled merge window 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z (4pm PT) for PR 4321
